name: Rule the Rabble
body:
Bending your lessers to your will is not a point of pride. It is merely a foregone conclusion.

Prerequisite(s): Supremacy focus, mesmerist level 9

Benefit(s): You may cast focus spells on any creature with at least 5 fewer Hit Dice than you have without expending spell slots until it succeeds on a saving throw against any of your spells or abilities. In addition, as a downtime activity, in any region where the average creature has at least 5 less hit dice than you, you may spend 1 day to ensure an area with a radius of up to medium range of a mesmerist spell you cast will be either cleared of or filled with an arbitrary number of bystanders in anticipation for a period of no longer than 8 hours on the following day. You may leave specific creatures unaffected if desired. An hour before or after this period, the crowd gradually thins or grows as appropriate. Each member of the crowd will have seemingly legitimate reasons to be present or absent (though many of those reasons will be false or fabricated by you). You may not cause overcrowding to the point where the crowd becomes a danger to itself or deprive the surrounding area of so many creatures that local life grinds to a halt. A crowd you create will not cause a disturbance outside of the norm for the area, and punishment for trespassing, if any, will be lenient. If the lowest possible punishment for trespassing in the area is incarceration, or lethal, the crowd will restrict itself to public places. If obstacles or terrain prevent creatures from accessing parts of the area at the designated time, they will congregate in parts they can access until that changes. When you influence the crowds in this way, roll a d20. On a 1, you influence or inconvenience someone important in a way that will come back to negatively impact you.
